verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a full REST API (with OpenAPI spec), CLI, and Python SDK covering the entire instance lifecycle—search, create, connect, monitor, and destroy—plus a dedicated 'vastai agent skill' explicitly designed to let AI coding assistants drive provisioning, deployment, and account management without human console interaction, and scoped API keys for CI/CD/automation use. missing for 10: no MCP server evidence, no independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent completing a full unattended provision-monitor-run-teardown cycle, and community reports note real-world reliability variance versus documented console metrics.
